title: Data Leakage & Memorization in LLMs
description: My core PhD research: developing methods to detect and quantify when large language models memorize training data instead of generalizing, with implications for privacy, IP, and trustworthy evaluation of code and text models.

title: AI for Software Engineering (AI4SE)
description: Applying and stress-testing LLMs on software engineering tasks — code generation, semantic similarity, multi-language code generation, and bug fixing — to understand where they generalize and where they fail.

title: Audio Deepfake Detection
description: Earlier work on synthetic voice generation and detecting deepfake audio through acoustic parameter analysis (energy, pitch, spectral and cepstral features), conducted at CITADEL, Burkina Faso.
